title: Reports of Israeli attacks in Gaza as it accuses Hamas of ‘blatant violation’ of ceasefire – Middle East crisis live
summary: Israeli media report attacks in Rafah and elsewhere in southern Gaza Israeli airstrikes hit Rafah in southern Gaza , Israeli and regional media report, as clashes flared between Israeli forces and Hamas despite a fragile US-brokered ceasefire. Israel’s public broadcaster Kan said the air force was striking targets in Rafah , while other outlets reported attacks elsewhere in southern Gaza and in the city of Jabalia in the north of the territory. Israeli TV network Channel 12 said prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a phone call with defence minister Israel Katz and senior army officials as the situation unfolded. Continue reading...
